name: POST /api/keys/:key_id/revoke — api-gateway
description: Revokes the API key named by the key_id path param and answers 200 with the updated key row. DEPRECATED ALIAS: /api/keys/:key_id/revoke is retained for older integrations and delegates, behind a deprecation preHandler, to the same tenant-scoped revokeKeyHandler as the canonical /api/api-keys/:key_id/revoke - the inline gateway implementation that once returned a bare {success:true} and demanded a `reason` was deleted. Edge cases: the revocation is now TENANT-SCOPED - revokeKey matches on (key_id, tenant_id) taken from the JWT, so another tenant's key is invisible and answers 404 rather than being revoked; the request body is IGNORED ENTIRELY - revokeKey takes only (key_id, tenant_id), nothing in packages/sdk-api-keys reads a `reason`, and there is no revocation-reason column or enum anywhere in the api_keys schema, so the field was dropped from the payload rather than documented with invented values; revocation is NOT idempotent in its response - a second revoke of the same key finds no ACTIVE row and returns the same 404 as a key that never existed, so the two cases are indistinguishable; a credential with no tenant_id claim (for example the /api/auth/register token, which creates only an identity.person with no tenant or membership) is refused by tenantOf() with a 400 before the key is ever looked up (MUST-52); a non-UUID key_id fails the uuid cast inside revokeKey and surfaces as a 500.

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in Bearer form - gateway default-deny authGate onRequest hook (AUTH_GATE_MODE=enforce)
Bearer token fails JWT verification in the gateway authGate

errorCases.message: This credential carries no tenant context
errorCases.when: the bearer token verifies but carries no tenant_id claim - tenantOf() refuses it before the key lookup

errorCases.message: No active key with that id
errorCases.when: revokeKey reports no row updated - the key_id does not exist for this tenant, belongs to another tenant, or was already revoked by an earlier call
revokeKey throws - a non-UUID key_id failing the uuid cast, or any DB error
